name: Karatina PHY 401: Compressor Thermodynamics Lab & Design Optimizer
description: Interactive thermodynamic workbench and computational design tool for Karatina University PHY 401 Thermal Physics II. Simulates isothermal, isentropic, and actual multi-stage air compression, intermediate pressure optimization, cooler entropy generation, 2D feasibility mapping, and 5,000-sample Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis.
